# Tiferes — Reader Critique Before Implementation

The Awtsmoos joins revealed control and concealed depth until both become one design;
Awtsmoos.com should make the reader powerful without making the reader feel like a machine.

## Thirty safeguards

1. Preserve the reading text as the strongest visual hierarchy.
2. Preserve every externally consumed reader ID.
3. Do not duplicate existing preference state.
4. Do not duplicate focus-mode state.
5. Do not duplicate sidebar state.
6. Keep typography and sidebar surfaces mutually non-obstructive.
7. Keep fixed controls inside safe-area boundaries.
8. Never use component `100vw` sizing.
9. Replace arbitrary z escalation with reader-local tokens.
10. Keep all touched reader selectors rooted locally.
11. Ensure 320px mobile remains horizontally scroll-free.
12. Make every actionable control at least touch-friendly.
13. Use hover styles only on hover-capable devices.
14. Give controls visible `:focus-visible` treatment.
15. Give controls tactile `:active` treatment without layout shift.
16. Preserve expanded/pressed ARIA truth through JavaScript gates.
17. Preserve Escape/outside-click dismissal where already expected.
18. Restore useful focus after dismissing transient surfaces.
19. Do not let settings obscure the active reading line unnecessarily.
20. Honor `prefers-reduced-motion`.
21. Preserve forced-colors legibility.
22. Keep dynamic custom tincture CSS confined to its existing runtime slot.
23. Do not replace native semantic disclosure with custom div toggles.
24. Keep preference persistence independent of surface rendering.
25. Keep event-listener setup idempotent.
26. Split touched executable modules above 120 lines.
27. Use tabs only in touched source.
28. Re-read every touched file from disk after writes.
29. Run reader-focused tests only after the code tranche is coherent.
30. Browser-verify narrow mobile and desktop geometry before declaring the reader tranche closed.

## Expected failure modes to hunt

- fixed controls covering header or text on narrow safe-area devices
- typography panel escaping viewport height
- competing popovers staying open simultaneously
- sidebar and typography state disagreeing with ARIA attributes
- reduced-motion still animating expensive surfaces
- hidden controls retaining keyboard focus
- style selectors leaking outside reader root
